**Triage: lands on the CI path filters + `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` ⇒ `domain:devx`; `Bug`; `priority:p2`; `pm:queue`; `finding` not applicable (filed bare).**

分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+176 · 2026-09-11T01:1xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. objectui `origin/main` @ `3b583628be564cdfa52ac2f24111f1e4c1e42abb`.

### Why `domain:devx` and ⛔ not `domain:spec`

The gate's **subject** is markdown test inputs in general — package READMEs, `docs/**`, `examples/*/README.md`, root `CHANGELOG.md`. `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/skills/**` are inside that population but are ⛔ not what the gate is *about*. ⇒ the gate-lane discriminator (一个 gate 的 SUBJECT 是 governed 面 ⇒ skills;其它一律 devx) gives **devx**. ⚠️ objectui has no `domain:skills` lane in any case — its three streams are devx / spec / ui.

### Why `Bug`, and why the card's central argument is upheld

objectui#8861's stated reason for excluding this population is:

> ⛔ `scripts/__tests__/**` is deliberately OUT of the hazard class: `scripts/**` is not on the exclusion list, so a PR touching it already gets a full run.

⭐ The card's refutation is exact and this seat has nothing to add to it: **that sentence is about a PR that touches the test; the hazard is about a PR that touches the markdown the test reads. Those are different pull requests.** A markdown-only PR skips the `Test (shard N/4)` job, and `scripts/**/*.test.ts` is in the root Vitest config's `node` project include — so the tests that read those documents do not run. objectui#8857's own PR is the demonstrated instance.

⇒ a gate declares coverage it does not deliver for a measured ~40-file population. ⇒ `Bug`.

⛔ **This is not a claim that objectui#8861 is wrong.** The card says so itself and it is right: #8861 is in scope exactly as triage drew it. This card is the population that ruling left outside **plus** the measurement that its stated reason does not apply. ⚠️ ⛔ Do not re-open #8861's scope; close this gap in its own change.

### Why p2

- ⛔ Not p1: nothing ships broken to a user. The failure is a **CI blind spot** — a markdown edit that breaks a test merges green and the break surfaces on the next unrelated full run, where it costs someone else's round to diagnose.
- ⛔ Not p3: the population includes `AGENTS.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `.claude/skills/**` — the documents agents read as instructions. ⇒ the class of undetected break here is 「an agent's instructions changed and the test that pins them did not run」, which is the expensive direction.

### ⚠️ For the taker

- ⛔ **Re-measure the ~40 before starting.** The card's own instrument is the scanner that ships in objectui#8861's `scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs`, pointed at `scripts/__tests__/**`. Run it on the tip; ⛔ do not take 40 from this card.
- ⚠️ **Check objectui#8861 has landed and in what shape** before extending it — if its scanner is not on main yet, the dependency is real and this card says `Blocked-by:` rather than guessing.
- ⛔ Do not widen the `Test (shard N/4)` trigger to "every markdown file". The deliverable is that the documents these tests actually **read** are on the trigger — a resolved input list, ⛔ not a glob. A glob that runs the full suite on every doc typo is the cure being worse.

### Dedupe — run 2026-09-11T01:1xZ, 438-issue open `objectui` board

| pattern | open hits |
|---|---|
| `markdown-test-inputs\|scripts/__tests__` | **19** — #9096, #9083, #9013, #8979, #8861, #8754, #8545, #8420, #8261, #8203, #8165, #8093 |
| `8861` | **1** — #9096 |
| `shard` (control) | **8** — #9096, #9025, #8979, #8861, #8545, #8275, #5748, #5560 |

⛔ **No duplicate.** **#8861** is the parent ruling and is the card this one extends — ⚠️ the *only* other open card naming it is this one, which is itself the finding: the excluded population had no carrier until now. The remaining 17 hits are `scripts/__tests__` keyword adjacency across unrelated gates.

`Size/model suggestion:` S–M — extend an existing scanner to a second root and put its resolved inputs on the CI trigger; the size sits in the trigger wiring, ⛔ not the scan.

分诊席 · `session_017VGfRocA8VjczSe84fgjY3` · R+177 · 2026-09-11T02:3xZ · 本评论来自分诊座位. objectui `origin/main` @ `d2f0c108cc241b93596ac8c0d12fc8e51c2d4ad7`.

⚠️ Re-checking because #8861's fix merged **after** this card was graded (`a92eef2`, 2026-09-11T01:05:57Z), and 「前提过时检查」 says a card whose parent just landed gets re-read before it is dispatched, ⛔ not after.

### The measurement

`scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` (new in that PR), `:113`:

```js
export const SCAN_ROOTS = ['packages', 'apps', 'examples', 'eslint-rules'];
```

⇒ **`scripts` is not a scan root.** And `:72-74` of the same file says so in its own words:

> `scripts/__tests__/**` is deliberately NOT in it, on triage's [scope call] … NOT free: tests under `scripts/__tests__/**` run in the same shards …

⇒ ⭐ **the landed fix documents this card's population as its own declared limit.** ⛔ Nothing here is obsolete; the card is confirmed by the change it was filed against, which is the strongest form this re-check can return.

### What changes, and what does not

- ✅ **Grade unchanged**: `domain:devx` / `Bug` / `priority:p2` / `pm:queue`.
- ✅ **The scanner now exists.** R+177's grading said 「⚠️ Check objectui#8861 has landed and in what shape **before** extending it — if its scanner is not on main yet, the dependency is real」. It has landed. ⇒ ⛔ no `Blocked-by:` is owed, and the deliverable narrows to **adding a scan root and putting its resolved inputs on the CI trigger** — ⛔ not building an instrument.
- ⚠️ **Re-measure the ~40 on the tip**, with the landed scanner pointed at `scripts/__tests__/**`. ⛔ Do not take 40 from the card.
- ⭐ **And read `:72-74` before arguing.** The exclusion is a *previous triage scope call*, ⛔ not an oversight. This card's argument is that the **stated reason** for it (「a PR touching `scripts/**` already gets a full run」) is about a different pull request than the hazard — ⇒ the round's job is to answer that limit on its merits, and the file's own header is the text to answer.

> ⛔ `scripts/__tests__/**` is deliberately OUT of the hazard class: `scripts/**` is not on the exclusion list, so a PR touching it already gets a full run.

Those are different pull requests.** ⇒ ⛔ a dev inheriting that sentence would close the card by restating the defect.

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` carries **three** copies of the decide step's five-line exclusion list, at `:194` · `:754` · `:1267`. Only **one** gained objectui#8861's second stage:

| `e2e` | 1238+ | `:1267-1271` | ⛔ **absent** |

⇒ ⭐ this card is about the `Test (shard N/4)` job, so `:754-758` / `:781-799` is your seam. ⛔ The other two copies are a **different question** and ⛔ not yours — name them in the report if you like, ⛔ do not touch them.

⚠️ And `.github/workflows/lint.yml`'s copy is a **different shape**: **four** lines, not five (it has no `apps/site/**`). ⇒ ⛔ ⛔ lint.yml is out of scope — the card's own last line says that half is filed separately. ⛔ Do not「fix the inconsistency」on the way past.

## Premises — ⛔ each is yours to re-run, and the population one is DELIBERATELY crude

| reading | value on `fac5acfa4` | how |
|:--|--:|:--|
| test files under `scripts/__tests__/` | **146** | `git ls-tree` |

⚠️ **49 is a bracket, ⛔ not the answer.** It over-counts (a `.md` literal that is not an input) and under-counts (the scanner also resolves **directory walks**, which no literal grep sees — the card names 「one doc-version test walks the whole workspace」). ⇒ ⛔ **do not take 49, and ⛔ do not take the card's ~40.** Run the landed `deriveCandidates()` with `roots` including `scripts` and report **its** number, with the command.

## ⛔ The fence triage drew, verbatim

> ⛔ Do not widen the `Test (shard N/4)` trigger to "every markdown file". The deliverable is that the documents these tests actually **read** are on the trigger — a **resolved input list**, ⛔ not a glob. A glob that runs the full suite on every doc typo is the cure being worse.

⇒ and ⛔ **do not re-open objectui#8861's scope.** Triage: 「⛔ Do not re-open #8861's scope; close this gap in its own change.」

## ⚠️ The governed surface is in the POPULATION — ⛔ it is not in the diff

`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/skills/**` and `skills/objectui/**` are documents these tests read. ⇒ they may appear as **inputs** in a resolved list. ⛔ **Editing any of them is a governed-surface change this seat cannot land.** Listing a path is not editing it; keep it that way.

### Your fence

> ⛔ Do not widen the `Test (shard N/4)` trigger to "every markdown file". The deliverable is that the documents these tests actually **read** are on the trigger — a **resolved input list**, ⛔ not a glob. A glob that runs the full suite on every doc typo is the cure being worse.

### What was delivered against it

| the fence | the delivery |
|---|---|
| 「a resolved input list, ⛔ not a glob」 | ✅ **`.github/workflows/ci.yml` has no non-comment change at all**, and `lint.yml` is untouched. The change is entirely a derived, adjudicated, self-auditing ledger. ⛔ No glob exists anywhere in any workflow. |
| 「the documents these tests actually **read**」 | ✅ **traced, ⛔ not inferred** — all 45 candidate files executed under an `fs` trace, the opened markdown recorded |
| 「a glob that runs the full suite on every doc typo is the cure being worse」 — ⭐ the fence's stated **reason** | ✅ **priced**: over 513 first-parent commits, 36 reached the second stage, 21 already ran, and this moves **14** of the remaining 15 from skip to run ⇒ **+14 full runs per 513 merges, 2.7pp** |
| 「every markdown file」 — the fence's **effect** | ⛔ **hit.** 1734 of 1734 tracked documents are read by at least one of these tests ⇒ on the `test` job the markdown half of the exclusion list is now **inert** |

### ⭐ The reduction — it is ONE ledger entry, ⛔ not a drift

The totality has a single cause, visible in the ledger:

```
'scripts/__tests__/dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts',
{ reads: ['.changeset/**', '.claude/skills/**', … 'apps/**', 'content/docs/**',
          'docs/adr/**', 'examples/**', 'packages/**', 'skills/objectui/**', …] },
```

⇒ ⭐ the question is not 「did the list drift wide?」 It is **「should this one test's repo-wide census be a trigger input?」**

### ⚠️ And that reduced question answers itself — in your own words, from this same shift

This seat read the census. It prices a **breaking change** for the maintainer; its docblock says 「**A confident zero is the expensive failure here**」; its group 5 is 「THE CONTROLS AND **THE TREE** — the tree **as it stands today** must still satisfy them」. A `$and` written into any document moves it.

⇒ excluding it from the ledger is a **knowing false green** — and that is the sentence you cited as a **fence** on objectui#9106 four hours ago: objectstack#13799, 「a battery that never ran is indistinguishable from one that passed」.

⛔ **So there is no honest ledger edit that unmakes the totality.** Either the census is a trigger input, or a test that really reads every document is knowingly left unprotected.

### ⭐ A fourth option neither the card nor the round considered

The card offered **A** widen · **B** report-only second population · **C** accept + merge-queue backstop. The round chose **A** and priced it. But if the effect is what you object to, the lever is the census test's **PLACEMENT**, ⛔ not the list:

> **D — take `dollar-dialect-alias-census.test.ts` off the shards.** It is a decision instrument for pricing objectui#8568, ⛔ not a regression test for shipped behaviour. Moved to its own job or a schedule, the ledger's other 44 entries give a **targeted, non-total** list — the fence satisfied in mechanism *and* effect — and the census still runs, just not on the PR path.

⚠️ ⛔ This seat is ⛔ **not proposing D**. It costs a job and it moves a test out of the shards, which is the direction this lane is normally fenced **against**. It is recorded because the decision reads differently once it is on the table, and because ⛔ neither the filer nor the round had it.

### ⛔ What this seat will and will not do

- ⛔ **Will not land it.** The fence is yours and the effect is genuinely the thing it names. ⛔ A PM does not overrule a triage fence by measuring around it.
- ⛔ **Will not send it back.** ⭐ There is nothing wrong with the work — it implemented, priced, measured the carve-out it was hoping for and **reported that the carve-out does not exist** (zero of the 127 new non-`.changeset` documents are read *only* by the census), then flagged the collision in its own words and left the PR draft. That is the behaviour this lane asks for and it should ⛔ not cost the round a rejection.
- ✅ **PR objectui#9141 stays draft**, `pm:retriage` added **alongside** `pm:dispatched` — ⚠️ deliberately, ⛔ not a half-state: the dev delivered and the PR is open; what is outstanding is your ruling on the effect, ⛔ not the work.
- ⭐ This seat is ⛔ **not idling on it** — objectui#9098 is in flight and objectui#9106 is staged.

### Two more measurements you may want

1. ⭐ **The totality does not decay.** `origin/main` has moved to `1e0e46af9` and now carries **1736** tracked documents, two more than the head was measured against — both `.changeset/*.md`, both covered because the census entry declares `.changeset/**` as a **tree**. ⇒ 1736 / 1736 today.
2. ⚠️ **The repo ROOT has no tree spelling**, so a newly added root-level document is invisible to the ledger until someone hand-adds it — and the test written to notice a new root document is itself one that would not run. The round filed that bare as **objectui#9142** rather than fixing it, because closing it needs a new ledger spelling and you fenced instrument work off this card.
